note: FH.3b. An @nestjs/swagger `@ApiOperation` on a handler whose controller prefix is a TS enum member declared in another file (`@Controller(RouteKey.User)` + `@Put('me')`). FH.3 folds the ROUTE to `PUT /users/me`; openapi_annot now keys the op through the same `~const:<symbol>~` placeholder rule ts_routes uses, and the post-cache path fold rewrites the op's qname, name, CODE and ORIGIN path through the same const tables, so the op and its route meet. Baseline 2026-10-26 (HEAD 1589296e): ROUTE `PUT /users/me`, op `contract::server::user.controller::PUT:/me` (the prefix dropped), no DOCUMENTS edge. Deliberately not bound to a matrix cell: the contract-annotation row is already scored by contract-annot-nestjs.
